trigger: OpenCode works or resolves one way in a parent shell but fails, spawns, or resolves differently when launched through AgentSwitchboard, GNHF, a shim, WSL, or another child-process boundary.
inputs: requested runtime surface: native-windows, wsl-ubuntu, or unknown
exact operator or agent launch command
effective launch-process OpenCode resolution when available
process PATH snapshot for each observed boundary
AgentSwitchboard opencode.cmd shim content when present
GnhfFleet state agents.opencode commandPath and integration when present
bounded child stdout, stderr, exit code, and failing stage identity

steps.action: Record the requested runtime surface and exact launch chain before interpreting any command output.
Load runtime-resolution.registry.json and classify every discovered opencode command as native Windows, AgentSwitchboard WSL shim, WSL Ubuntu, or unknown.
Capture Get-Command opencode -All plus the parent process PATH. Treat this as parent-only evidence.
If %LOCALAPPDATA%\AgentSwitchboard\bin\opencode.cmd exists, capture its bounded text and target platform without executing or modifying it.
If GnhfFleet state.json exists, capture only the OpenCode adapter commandPath, integration, availability, and version fields needed for comparison.
When runtime authority and instrumentation exist, capture which OpenCode executable the exact child launch chain resolves before task execution; otherwise mark the boundary unresolved.
Capture bounded stdout, stderr, exit code, and first divergent boundary. Do not replace failing evidence with a parent-shell success probe.
Route the collected packet to path-collision-diagnosis.workflow.json.
Emit the registered untracked classification, English operator report, and final handoff with one exact next action.

failureRules: If requested runtime surface is unknown, classification cannot pass.
If the effective launch identity is missing, do not infer it from opencode debug config, state.json, or a parent Get-Command result.
If a native-windows request selects the AgentSwitchboard WSL shim, classify fail-closed.
If child diagnostics are missing after a spawn failure, stop proof promotion at the first unresolved boundary.
forbidden: installing or reinstalling OpenCode, Hermes, uv, Node, or WSL
claiming runtime proof from configuration or parent-shell discovery
